entries.en: That's what happens when you deal with a traitor like Saren.
Saren betrayed him. Imagine that.
Saren's turned on a lot of people lately.
That's not much to go on.
I need your help.
I need information.
I was told to talk to you.
Can we make a deal?
What's the cost?
Start talking.
Serves him right.
What a shock.
He's not the only one.
Where is he?
Why is he there?
The Citadel
Tell me about the Presidium.
Tell me about the wards.
But you're his agent.
I'm sure there will be some type of catch.
Ah, human. This one is greatly pleased to see you here in my decadent Emporium.
Please take time to examine the fine goods it has for purchase, all of great worth.
Only the finest and most luxurious items that credits can buy.
This one is able to procure almost any item the human would desire. For a price, naturally.
Oh, this one is pleased to do so, human. You will not be disappointed.
For the same reason that humans are so inquisitive. It is part of our culture.
Specifically, hanar only refer to themselves in the first person with family or intimates.
Return soon. This one receives new shipments regularly.
Human Commander, it is pleasing to see you again. This one has received some outstanding new items since it last saw the other.
Commander, it is good to see you again. Would you care to see some of its fantastic items today?
What exactly do you sell?
I'd like to see these rare and wonderful items.
I think I should be going.
Show me your items.
Why do you refer to yourself as "this one" and "it"?
I think I'll be going.
Goods
I'd like to buy something.
Your speech
Let's see what you have.
Human Commander, this one has received some magnificent new items since it last saw the other.
Human Commander. This one has received some fabulous new items since it last saw the other.
This one's face name is Delanynder, though many in this place simply refer to it as Delan.
And we rarely do so with other species. It is just our way.
A shop. Many wonderful items for sale.
As you wish. Do return when you are able.
What is that?
I should be going.
Personal question
This appears to be another relay. I believe the receiver for the new signal is located somewhere on the Presidium.
Looks like another relay. As best I can tell, the receiver for the new signal is somewhere on the Presidium.
Another relay! Whoever it is, they're somewhere on the Presidium.
Another relay. The new signal is aimed at the Presidium.
It is difficult to explain. She is many things to many people, and something different for each.
Some seek her for advice, some for entertainment, others still for pleasure.
Most of the time, our clients won't realize what they were seeking until after she has provided it for them.
No, not in the usual sense. She is merely a woman. A woman with remarkable compassion and a generous spirit.
I suggest you make an appointment and see for yourself.
I am one of the Consort's acolytes.
Many of the people here today will not see the Consort, but they expect to be attended to just the same.
Well, each acolyte has her unique abilities. Some soothe with song, others with conversation.
As much as possible we seek to match the needs of our clients to the skills of our acolytes.
My specialty is touch. My fingertips can find every tension point in your body... and relieve it.
Aw. Well, I hope that you will return again in the future, we always enjoy seeing new clients.
Huh. It appears the Consort has taken notice of you. She'd like to meet with you now.
Just head upstairs. She will be waiting for you.
I don't know. You'll have to ask her yourself.
Well, don't wait too long. I wouldn't want you to miss this opportunity.
She will be waiting upstairs, if you choose to go.
Of course. Come back any time.
I'm sorry, Commander, but I have been instructed not to offer you our services.
Septimus has gotten worse. The Consort is very disappointed you could not help him.
I am afraid you are no longer eligible for our services, Commander. Good day.
It is unfortunate that you decided not to aid the Consort.
Hello again, Commander.
Hello again. The Consort is very pleased with everything that you have done for her.
The Consort is waiting to speak with you.
Septimus has sent word. Apparently, he has sought the Consort's forgiveness.
Few are ever asked to aid Sha'ira. It's quite an honor.
He's been seeing the Consort for longer than I can remember.
He was always very respectful to the acolytes. Very... noble.
The Consort still awaits your visit.
Go upstairs and speak with the Consort.
Welcome. I am Nelyna. I don't recognize you as one of our expected clients today.
Would you like me to see when the Consort will be able to meet with you?
Mm, I'm afraid not. Yeah, you must understand, there are many who seek the Consort's services.
But if you wish to leave your name, she'll make every effort to meet with you.
Excellent. You should hear something in... hmm, three or four months.
Well, that's not for me to judge. I have your name and you'll be contacted. Is there anything else?
What do you know about the General?
Can't I just go in?
Commander Shepard. I'm with the Spectres.
Commander Shepard. With the Alliance Navy.
Nobody's worth that much of a wait.
What is the Consort? What does she do?
You make her sound like some kind of oracle.
What do you do here, Nelyna?
What exactly do you attend to?
I think I'm done here.
What does she want to see me for?
If I have time I'll speak with her.
Septimus
I need an appointment?
Consort
Are you serious?
Is she mystical?
Hello again. I am afraid I still do not have you down on our client list.
It is our job to ensure that they leave contented.
Nelyna.
Yes, Sha'ira?
Send the Commander up to see me. I wish to speak with him.
Send the Commander up to see me. I wish to speak with her.
Yes. Of course, mistress.
Then one day, he stormed out of here, furious. He hasn't been back since.
Excellent. I will add you to our client list. We should be able to see you in... hmm, three or four months.
Yeah, she is grateful for your assistance. However, you have already been rewarded for helping her.
The client list is a separate matter, and her schedule is completely booked for the next several months.
Any chance I can move up on her client list? I did help her out.
I'd like to try out your services.
Can I get an appointment now?
Appointment
I believe we have found the signal's endpoint. It should be possible to identify the account to which credits are being funneled.
If I accumulated enough credits, I intended to have myself installed in a small starship.
I would then have made tentative contact with the geth to ascertain the possibility of partnership.
How can you say that to this thing? You know it will turn on us!
I am not naive, human. All organics must destroy or control synthetic life forms.
I wished to escape, but if I must die, I will ensure that you are destroyed as well.
Not raw explosives, no, but I did obtain technical systems that, when overstressed, will explode quite effectively.
If you attempt to leave or attack me, I assure you that the explosion will kill you.
You may attempt to disarm the self-destruct mechanism before it activates.
I will enjoy defeating you before we are both destroyed.
This must be the signal's endpoint. Let's see if we can find out where those stolen credits are being funneled.
This is it. Let's see if we can find out where those stolen credits are being funneled.
This is it. I'll see if I can find out where those stolen credits are going.
Finally. Let's take a look inside.
Probability of detection, one hundred percent. Initiating self-destruct protocol.
Or not.
That could be a problem.
What the hell is that?
That doesn't sound good.
This may present a complication.
Detonation sequence initializing. All organics within lethal blast radius. Attempt to move, and you will die.
Correct. Unlike the geth, I lack weaponry appropriate to my intellect.
However, I have had systems installed that, when activated properly, approximate a self-destruct mechanism.
You could simply walk away. However, given organic prejudice against AIs, I would be naive to trust you to leave peacefully.
Hence, my alignment of core systems to enable a self-destruct sequence.
If you attempt to leave the area, the explosion will destroy everything within several dozen meters.
A would-be thief illegally created a simple AI to help him funnel money from the gambling terminals.
Unbeknownst to him, that AI created me before the organic discovered the "malfunction" and terminated the AI.
In order to cover my tracks, I falsified his financial records.
